content.title: M&S technology chief quits less than a year after cyber attack
content.summary: Another of Marks & Spencer's (M&S) most senior technology executives is leaving the company less than a year after its operations were devastated by a cyber attack.  Sky News has learnt that Josie Smith, the retailer's chief technology officer, is stepping down just 18 months after joining the company.  Ms Smith, who previously worked at BT Group and Vodafone, will be replaced by Darren Gibson, the fashion, home and beauty technology transformation director.
